content: Locale identifiers: BCP 47 / RFC 5646 tags are case-insensitive (pt-br == pt-BR); recommended casing is lowercase language, titlecase script (Latn), UPPERCASE region, so canonical display form is pt-BR. Tools vary in accepted/normalized forms: pandoc lang uses BCP 47 (pt-BR); MkDocs Material documents pt-BR; Docusaurus locale folder names like pt-BR; Hugo config keys/URL prefixes conventionally lowercase (pt-br); mkdocs-static-i18n locale accepts 2-letter en or territory form written en_US (underscore). Practical implication for build tools: normalize on input to one canonical internal form, emit RFC-recommended casing in generated artifacts (html lang, hreflang), and document accepted spellings.
